approvers: Owner decides; main contractor if it touches their finishes
reason: We spend about 3k a year on film and tape applied by our own lads at around 12 a m2. Paying 19 for a coating is over 50% more for something we already solve cheaply, and I would rather not have a stranger's applicator near finished frames.
objection: Anything sprayed or rolled onto coated glass and powder-coated frames could leave residue, stain the finish or lift it on peeling, and then it is my name on the defect claim. For 19 a m2 against film that costs almost nothing, the risk is not worth it.
instead: Keep using self-adhesive film, plastic sheet and tape applied by our own labour, from the suppliers we have used for years.
would_change_my_mind: Written confirmation from my glass and coating suppliers that it is compatible with our finishes, plus a reference from another glazing contractor who used it, at a price close to what film costs me now.
